# Bhikkhu Vibhaṅga Sekhiya 30 (Bu-Vb Sk30)

**Section:** Bhikkhu Vibhaṅga (bu-vb)

## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature and SuttaCentral)
*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and SuttaCentral data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*
*Samatittika* ("Not receiving on an even level") is the thirtieth rule in the *Sekhiya* (rules of training) division of the Vinaya Piṭaka's *Bhikkhu Vibhaṅga* [SuttaCentral]. The text sets out an etiquette training rule concerning the proper manner of receiving almsfood into the bowl, translated into English by Bhikkhu Brahmali [SuttaCentral].
The rule has extensive parallels across early Buddhist monastic traditions [SuttaCentral]. Curated full parallels exist within the Pali tradition in the *Bhikkhu Pātimokkha* (Sekhiya 30), the *Bhikkhu Parivāra* (Sekhiya 30), and the corresponding nuns' Vinaya texts (*Bhikkhunī Vibhaṅga*, *Bhikkhunī Pātimokkha*, and *Bhikkhunī Parivāra* Sekhiya 30) [SuttaCentral]. Parallel rules titled *Samatittika* or concerning the proper reception of food are likewise preserved in the Sanskrit, Chinese, and Tibetan Vinayas of the Sarvāstivāda, Mūlasarvāstivāda, Mahīśāsaka, Dharmaguptaka, and Kāśyapīya schools, as well as the *Upāliparipṛcchā* [SuttaCentral]. SuttaCentral additionally identifies resembling parallels in Vinaya rules concerning respectful reception of curry and alms (*Satkṛtya sūpaṁ pratigṛhīṣyāma* and *Sakkaccapaṭiggahaṇa*, e.g., Sekhiya 27) [SuttaCentral].
Within the Pali canon, DharmaNexus identifies 107 matching passages shared across 42 texts [DharmaNexus]. These matches consist of formulaic phrasing and shared legal structures common to the *Sekhiya* chapter, sharing substantial passages with adjacent rules such as Sekhiya 29 (§0.1–1.7.1), Sekhiya 24 (§0.1–1.10), Sekhiya 31 (§0.1–1.10), and Sekhiya 27 (§0.1–1.7.1) [DharmaNexus].
*No discussion of this text was found in the reference-literature corpus; the overview relies on SuttaCentral and DharmaNexus data.*
